blocks.text: Biogeochemical cycles kimiyai anasir (chemical elements), jaise carbon, nitrogen, oxygen aur phosphorus, ki ecosystem ke zinda (biotic) aur be-jaan (abiotic) hisson ke darmiyan chakkar wali harkat (cyclic movement) hain. Yaani yeh anasir mahol se jandaron mein aate hain aur phir wapas mahol mein chale jate hain.

blocks.prompt: Biogeochemical cycles mein chalne wale do anasir (elements) batayein.
blocks.explanation: Koi do: carbon, nitrogen, oxygen, phosphorus.

items: Biogeochemical cycles: carbon, nitrogen, oxygen, phosphorus jaise anasir ka zinda aur be-jaan hisson ke darmiyan chakkar.
